Theorem
[Geometric tameness implies topological tameness] 1. 9.4.1\group thurston.ch09.tamenessSource: thurston:page-0256Source: thurston:page-0257 A geometrically tame end of $N-P$ is homeomorphic, outside a compact set, to $S\times [0,\infty )$.
Proof

\sketch Exhaust the end by properly embedded uncrumpled surfaces with controlled geometry; the ruled regions between successive surfaces give product blocks, and the blocks assemble to a product outside a compact set.

□
